nom: La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Oil Control Face Serum

segments.oily: The dominant skin type among reviewers; most report it reduces shine and keeps the T-zone matte through the day without drying out skin, though a couple say they still felt oily or saw no oil-control effect.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances oily and dry areas at once, controlling shine on the T-zone while keeping cheeks hydrated.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation even with the 12% vitamin C and salicylic acid, though one reviewer with sensitive Asian skin found it worsened her skin's texture over a month, and another recommends patch-testing and introducing it slowly.
segments.dry: The reviewer who specifies dry skin found it balanced her workday oiliness without over-drying.

concerns.oiliness: Oil control is the headline benefit reviewers test for; most report visibly reduced shine and a matte T-zone by end of day, though a few say it didn't reduce their oiliness or that their skin still got oily.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading dark spots and a more even skin tone within a few weeks to a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts and calmer active acne thanks to the salicylic acid; one reviewer, however, felt it made her skin's texture worse over a month.
concerns.aging: Reviewers report softened fine lines and improved firmness with continued use, particularly around the eyes and mouth, though results are described as gradual.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness and faster fading of red spots.
concerns.dehydration: Despite being an oil-control serum, many reviewers with normally oily or combination skin say it doesn't leave them feeling dry, and the reviewer with dry skin reports it stays sufficiently hydrating.

aspects.libelle: Oxidizes and turns yellow or orange over time
Good value versus pricier vitamin C serums
Can feel slightly sticky right after application

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been hunting for a vitamin c product that works on my skin, and so far no go. The left photo is me before & right photo is after one month of use. I do like the texture of this, but it just didn't work for me. It sinks into the skin quickly and has an almost sticky finish which seemed to work well under makeup. As for overall quality, it made the texture of my skin worse over time somehow. I tried switching to using it less (1-2 times a week), and it was still too much. Maybe my skin just isn't mature enough for it yet.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this for free from @influenster and @larocheposay in exchange for my honest opinion. This is a very good vitamin C serum for the price. I switched to this brand because I could no longer justify spending significantly more for a marginally better product. The salicylic acid works well for my acne prone aging skin. It does have a distinct fragrance, which I am not crazy about and it does oxidize and turn yellow, which is typical of products containing L-ascorbic acid. I do wish it came in an amber colored (instead of clear) bottle to help slow this process. Overall I appreciate its brightening and anti-aging effects and consider it a great value for its relatively low price, so I will continue to incorporate it into my morning routine. This is one to Definitely give a try. I will be continuing to use this for the foreseeable future!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Oil Control Serum and really like it. It goes on light, helps with shine, and makes my skin look brighter without feeling heavy. Great option if you've got oily skin.

I received the La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Oil Control Serum as a free gift in exchange for my honest review. As a mom of 3 in my mid-40s, I've noticed that while my skin isn't oily all the time, I definitely have some oily spots, especially when I wear makeup. I found that this serum helped to balance those areas, keeping my foundation looking fresh and even throughout the day. It absorbs quickly and feels light on my skin. The added skincare benefits of a vitamin C serum are a huge bonus, and I love that it helps with the appearance of wrinkles and gives my aging skin a healthy glow. This is a great product for anyone looking for oil control and anti-aging benefits.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Oil Control Serum for a few weeks now, and honestly, I'm really happy with the results. I have oily skin on my forehead, cheeks, and chin that's prone to breakouts and dullness, so I've always been a bit cautious with Vitamin C products—some have either irritated my skin or made me look shiny within hours. But this serum is completely different. It's super lightweight and sinks in quickly, which I really appreciate. No sticky feeling, no heavy residue. I noticed pretty early on that my skin looked fresher and more even-toned, and over time, some of my dark spots have faded noticeably. What really impressed me, though, is the oil control. My skin stays matte much longer throughout the day, and I've noticed fewer clogged pores and breakouts. It feels like this serum hits that perfect balance: it brightens and smooths without overloading my skin. Plus, it works well under sunscreen and makeup, which is a huge bonus for me. Definitely a new staple in my routine—I'll be sticking with this one!

extraits.titre: New permanent staple in my skincare routine!!!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] New permanent staple in my skin care routine!!! Delivers as promised: immediately making my skin less oily, feel and look better overall. After two weeks, my skin tone was more even. No more redness splotchy skin! First product to do that for me. I was good about using this twice daily and after a month, my skin was less oily overall and pores were smoothing out. Worth the $45 price tag as just a 1 oz bottle has lasted 2 months with a third of the bottle left!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am acne prone and constantly struggling with acne marks and this was a perfect hybrid serum to combat active acne and PIH marks and spots! The salicylic acid content was gentle enough for morning use and the consistency works great layered and under makeup. My only concern is the translucent bottle and the efficacy of the vitamin C over time and oxidisation but otherwise I'm happy with performance!
